<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI deposit rating policy:</strong> The Reserve Bank of India is moving to distance itself from bank deposit ratings, a shift that may alter how risk is assessed in the domestic banking sector.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Kisan Credit Card subvention:</strong> The government is in discussions with banks to reduce interest subvention on Kisan Credit Cards by 50 basis points, potentially impacting rural credit dynamics.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
</ul>
